title: Shell surface polish follow-up
description: Owner-requested M10 follow-on after surface stacking merge 07c8544. The approved design set is the registered umbrella shell-polish design plus six focused designs: metrics/control-centre/GPU, bar weather/launcher/workspaces, centre clock/media/wordmark, notifications/battery/urgency, owned tray termination, and Control Centre Network. Preserve existing owners sysc-121, sysc-82, sysc-157, sysc-254, sysc-268, and the weather issues; qualify sysc-notify and sysc-tray changes upstream before shell integration.
design: Execution children: sysc-314 owns the centre clock/media/fixed-wordmark composition; sysc-315 owns notification urgency and the qualified battery producer; sysc-316 owns sysc-tray termination qualification and shell acknowledgement; sysc-317 owns cross-slice Registry/bar integration, final gates, and the completion handover. The umbrella design is docs/plans/2026-09-16-shell-polish-design.md and the six focused designs are registered beside it.
acceptance_criteria: All nine handover areas have focused tests, affected-package gates, and bare-metal Niri evidence. No fake metric values, hidden-only tray removals, duplicated data paths, or wordmark drift. Cross-repository protocol work is tracked before shell integration. All seven registered designs have executable plans before code changes, and sysc-327 closes only with the M10 completion handover.

title: M10 centre composition: clock, media, fixed wordmark
description: Execute docs/plans/2026-09-16-centre-clock-media-wordmark-design.md. Make the default time/date one visible composition, keep media optional at its right edge, and anchor the SYSC wordmark at the bar content-band centre as widths and player state change.
design: Use the existing clock, media, wordmark, retained-tree, and ArrangeBar seams. Add no general layout toolkit or new media protocol. Keep all service work off Registry.mu and the Wayland dispatch loop.
acceptance_criteria: Focused build and layout tests prove one time/date group, media collapse and bounded title behavior, stable accessible actions, and an invariant wordmark centre across side-width and media variations. A DP-1 bare-metal bar check records no leaked or drifting composition.

title: M10 notifications and battery warning
description: Execute docs/plans/2026-09-16-notifications-battery-urgency-design.md. Give low, normal, and critical cards semantic urgency treatment and integrate one hysteretic, deduplicated battery warning through a qualified sysc-notify producer.
design: sysc-notify remains the record and FDO publisher. The shell consumes the shared battery snapshot and sends a bounded replacement-key command only through the qualified producer; no local notification database or fake success.
acceptance_criteria: Focused shell tests prove all urgency roles, critical accessibility treatment, stable unread geometry, and battery enter/hold/recovery, reconnect, invalid-input, and producer-failure behavior. The sysc-notify producer protocol and daemon tests pass before the shell pin changes; the live gate does not spam notification history or invent a battery reading.

title: M10 tray termination and external qualification
description: Execute docs/plans/2026-09-16-owned-tray-termination-design.md. Define, test, tag, and pin the sysc-tray owned termination operation, then add the shell Close row and acknowledgement path.
design: Ownership, PID/start-time validation, lifecycle authority, and process operations stay in sysc-tray. sysc-shell adds no os.Kill, PID parsing, hidden-only removal, or arbitrary process signalling.
acceptance_criteria: sysc-tray protocol and daemon tests reject unsupported, stale, recycled, cross-UID, and busy identities; accept only a same-UID current owned item; request bounded graceful termination; and publish the matching item delta. Shell tests send only the full ItemKey, keep the row visible on rejection or timeout, and report success only after removal. A disposable fixture or an explicit unrun live gate is recorded without touching unrelated tray applications.

title: M10 integration and exit gate
description: Execute the seven registered M10 designs as coordinated slices, preserve existing owners for metrics, weather, launcher, and Network, and run the final integration and bare-metal Niri gate described by docs/plans/2026-09-16-shell-polish-design.md.
design: Own Registry/bar composition and cross-slice review. Reject fake metrics, duplicate service paths, wordmark drift, hidden-only tray removal, and work performed under Registry.mu or the Wayland dispatch loop.
acceptance_criteria: All seven designs have executable plans and focused checks; the CC, System Monitor, bar, Network page, notification, tray, launcher, workspace, and centre projections share their existing owners and truthful unavailable paths; gofmt, vet, race, module-diff, and diff checks are recorded; DP-1 at 3440x1440 scale 1.0 is inspected with niri msg -j layers before and after affected surfaces; hardware-limited omissions are recorded; sysc-309 closes only with a completion handover.
